newsitem.title: CHINA: China to spend $938 million on Three Gorges in '97.
newsitem.headline: China to spend $938 million on Three Gorges in '97.

text.p: China will spend 7.79 billion yuan ($938 million) on the giant Three Gorges dam project in 1997, 200 million yuan more than last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Crews would move some 26 million cubic metres (33 million cubic yards) of earth and stone this year for the project that will dam the mighty Yangtze River, two million cubic metres (2.6 million cubic yards) more than in 1996, Xinhua said.

Officials say the project to build the 175-metre-high (570 ft) dam in the central province of Hubei will cost at least 240 billion yuan by the time it is completed in 2009 if interest and inflation are taken into account.

Officials of the China Three Gorges Project Development Corp said last year they faced a funding shortage of one-sixth of the dam's price tag but have vowed to finish it even if sought-after foreign funding fails to materialise.
